entry.description: Rip discs, check known-dump CRCs, and recover damaged sectors. Stop and resume at any time.
Play GDI, CDI, and ISO game images from SD or IDE storage. Set loading options for each game.
Browse your installed game collection and launch a favorite from its cover artwork.
Browse your devices, copy and organize files, and open supported files and applications.
Browse your VMU, back up saves to storage, and restore saved games to a memory card.
Play the disc in your Dreamcast's original GD-ROM drive.
Configure your network connection and connect DreamShell to other devices.
Adjust DreamShell's startup, display, sound, and other system preferences.
View and capture images with the Dreamcast Dreameye camera.
Measure transfer performance on your connected storage devices.
Run memory checks to investigate possible Dreamcast hardware faults.
Read or program a flash BIOS chip on compatible modified hardware.
Change console region settings on supported hardware configurations.
Dump cartridge data using a compatible cartridge interface.
Configure arcade hardware and supported arcade game setups.
Configure the MIE JVS interface for supported arcade controls and hardware.
